verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase is a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console. First-party docs say it generates schemas, queries and mutations on demand, deciphers error messages, analyzes logs, and gives Crashlytics crash root-cause analysis with suggested fixes. It also answers questions about Firebase products and generates code. Missing for 10: evidence that it explains the user's own project or backend configuration rather than Firebase products in general, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
